text:
mike: Heads up — a bunch of CI shards started failing after the gcc13 toolchain bump. Seeing link errors in //third_party/protobuf:proto_static. Anyone else?
sarah: same here on linux-asan, looks like undefined refs to abi::__cxa_demangle stuff :(
jordan: can you paste full linker error?
mike: sure, here are the top lines from the failing shard:
```
bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/third_party/protobuf/libproto.a(proto.o): undefined reference to `__cxa_guard_acquire'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
ci-bot: Failed tests: //integration:proto_roundtrip (flaky=false) — build #4251
sarah: local reproduce command: `bazel build //third_party/protobuf:proto_static --config=gcc13 --verbose_failures` — hits the same link step
ben: @eng-infra-oncall can you help bisect? If it's a toolchain image change we should narrow commits quickly. :eyes:
eng-infra-oncall: Got it. Please provide a suspect git range and I'll run the bisect job.
mike: suspect range: `1a2b3c4..9f8e7d6` — bump of gcc image + linker flags happened in that window. I'm starting a quick manual bisect now.
jordan: quick thought: sometimes the new linker drops some implicit symbols, try forcing a different ld or linkopts, but that's a frag fix.
mike: added a temporary CI workaround to unblock other builds: added linkopts to the target to force `--no-as-needed`. Patch snippet:
```
cc_library(
  name = "proto_static",
  linkopts = ["-Wl,--no-as-needed"],
)
```
sarah: re-ran the failing shard with the workaround — it moved past the link step. Good for now but we need the root cause.
eng-infra-oncall: kicked off bisect CI jobs for the range — jobs 3123456901-3123456905. I'll post results as they complete.
ben: if bisect shows image change, we can stage a rollback of the image in prod to buy time.
mike: update: bisect narrowed it down to commit `9f8e7d6` (gcc image bump). Assigning @jordan to open an issue with reproduction steps, bisect log, and a proposed fix/change to toolchain packaging.
jordan: on it — will open GH issue, add bisect logs and the minimal repro, pinging compiler/toolchain folks. ETA: a few hours.
sarah: thanks all — leaving the temporary workaround in CI until we have a path forward. Please @mention if you need me to iterate on the repro. :thumbsup:
